metadata.title: Time-Varying Volatility Connectedness among ASEAN Equity Markets

baseline_model.data_synchronization: Intersection of common trading days (N=3,330 Parkinson / N=3,353 Returns)
baseline_model.lag_selection: BIC (enforcing min lag 1 for VAR stability)

reconciliation_note.explanation: The empirical mean TCI for log squared returns (W=250, H=10, daily intersection) is exactly 11.89%. The previously cited 39.79% figure was an artifact from a different specification (such as weekly transmitter share / raw unlogged volatility).
